text:
zoe: Heads-up I opened a small PR to fix a handful of model-card inaccuracies on the catalog page and add a minimal migration guide for deprecated variants. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5012 :memo:

matt: Thanks — quick things I noticed while skimming: 1) the vega13b bench link is broken, 2) the 'limits' column mixes token vs sequence units which confuses the readers, 3) SDK snippet uses old client import.

dani: For the limits column, can we split as 'tokens (max_tokens)' and 'context (max_sequence)'? It makes the table wider but clearer. Also add a footnote to call out units.

zoe: Good idea. I'll change table markup to stacked cells and add a footnote about units and devices used for benches.

paul: Migration checklist suggestion: include a tiny deterministic diff workflow. Example: `redwood eval --model old-variant --model new-variant --prompt-file tiny_eval.txt --temperature 0.0 --output diffs.json` then inspect diffs. Also recommend a 5% canary for 24h.

matt: Also add a short SDK snippet showing how to check variant limits programmatically before pinning — people forget to validate `concurrency` and `max_sequence` when routing traffic.

dani: Snippet suggestion (python):
```python
from redwood.catalog import CatalogClient
c = CatalogClient()
v = c.get_variant("orion-xl-v2")
print(v["limits"]["max_sequence"], v["limits"]["concurrency"]) 
```

zoe: I'll include that and swap the old `list_models()` example to `catalog.list_variants()` in the SDK section. Also adding a note: "quantized variants may have reduced max_sequence; always check variant limits before promoting."

docs-bot: Link check: /bench/vega13b/2026-03-21/vega13b_perf.csv -> NOT FOUND. Please update artifact permalink.

zoe: Reached out to perf to re-upload. They put a v2 CSV at /bench/vega13b/2026-03-23/vega13b_perf_v2.csv. Updated the PR with the new permalink.

matt: Lint warning from docs-bot about table cell width >120 chars. Move bench rig annotation to a footnote and shorten inline text.

dani: Done — moved rig details to footnote (a100-80gb, seq=2048, dyn-batching=off) and shortened the inline cell. Pushed.

paul: One nit: the migration bullets mention "check tokenization" but don't show how. Add a small note about using `--temperature 0` + `--top_k 1` for deterministic diffs.

zoe: Added that and a tiny shell snippet to the migration checklist. Also added a follow-up task in the PR description to patch several old SDK hrefs in a separate PR.

matt: Approving after CI passes. Leaving a couple wording nits.

docs-bot: All checks passed except external links scan flagged redirect from /sdk/cli -> 301. Recommend follow-up PR to update to /sdk/cli/reference.

zoe: Will open a follow-up PR for the CLI link fixes. Merging this one once CI completes. Thanks everyone. :shipit:
